# appgatesdp_discovered_apps_top_groups (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v24, v25.

## Schema

- `app_id` (String) ID of the app.
- `top_group_membership_counts` (Attributes List) List of top user groups with their membership counts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--top_group_membership_counts))
